name: cicada-local-tasks
description: Local Cicada task authority for explicit AI execution, stages, results, and human review.

interface.shortDescription: Read and report work against native Cicada tasks
interface.longDescription: Connects to an explicitly configured local Cicada profile through the existing authenticated Windows pipe client. Task UUID, stage, result, and review remain in Cicada.
defaultPrompt: Use Cicada for the exact task UUID and keep stage, result, and review state synchronized.
Do not invent a task or mark a result accepted without the user's review.
